title: Thank-you remarks and praise for power and driver aids
summary: This topic centers on brief thank-you comments, with the clear opinions praising the car overall, its power, and features such as sensors and cameras.

positive.summary: Positive reviews express gratitude while specifically praising the car experience, overall appeal, power, and all-round sensors and cameras.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews are very short thank-you messages that do not provide enough detail to identify a concrete vehicle aspect or clear evaluation.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are extremely short thank-you statements with limited detail.
